task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: The robot navigates to the box stack, picks the top box (BOX_TOP), places it on TEMP_TABLE, then picks the now-exposed BOX_MIDDLE and places it on INSPECTION_TABLE, and finally returns BOX_TOP back to the stack on BOX_BOTTOM.
assumptions: The stack is at (2.0, -1.0) and within interaction distance from the robot after navigation.
TEMP_TABLE and INSPECTION_TABLE are reachable locations that exist in the world.
The robot can navigate to each location with tolerance 0.5.
